goal: Resize a disposable Microsoft Paint canvas and export a PNG

target.identity_validation: installed package identity plus accessibility window title

procedure: Select Pixels and disable Maintain aspect ratio
Set Horizontal and Vertical dimensions with zero skew
Apply and observe the canvas-size label
Save As with PNG selected explicitly, not inferred from the filename extension

authorization.scope: disposable document and new output path

verification.required: independent PNG signature and IHDR dimensions

invalidation: PNG signature, digest, or IHDR mismatch
limitations: Microsoft Paint exposes no supported programmatic mutation API used by INDRO
the canonical CLI verifies the artifact but does not execute the UI recipe
checksum integrity is not authenticated provenance
